terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, deponent, with the accusative
evidence: Cic. Fam. 16.1.2: sī statim nāvigās, nōs Leucade cōnsequēre (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “by following after any person or thing, to reach, overtake, come up with”.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 287.
